posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body:
It's quite vague indeed, the issue for your text offscreen is that the width of the command window (with the choices between skills, items, quit etc.) is too big. From the script you've shared, none of them seem to modify this width. If you remove theses scripts, I suspect your issue will remain (please tell me if that is the case or not).
Check in
Window_MenuCommand
, you should have this code for
window_width
:
Ruby:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Width
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    return 160
  end
If you have something else than 160, please change it back to the original code.
If that does not solve the issue or if it was the original value, look for the method by searching
def window_width
(Ctrl+shift+f in the script editor).
You can ignore all base scripts from this list:
And look for other entries, for each of them, check in which class they are (the modified one will be in class Window_MenuCommand).
Don't modify them, just tell us here which scripts have this method in the aforementioned class.
